The answer box, one tap from the preview
elements.reason: drawn only where the planner's check says this console can build the answer, so a box never refuses after the answer is typed; its maxlength is the action's bound, 8,192 (kit.mjs ANSWER_MAX), but the action counts UTF-8 bytes and a browser counts characters, so the limit is a hint: an answer within 8,192 characters and past 8 KiB is refused at the preview, never cut
